code='''def transform(grid):
    # Repeat the non-divider pattern into every matching blank tile.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    zeros = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 0 for v in row)]
    if zeros:

        tile = grid[:sep]
        out = [row[:] for row in grid]
        for r in range(sep + 1, h):

        return out
    return [row[:] for row in grid]
